@graph.name: Returns & Refund Policy | The Toronto Sauna Co.
@graph.description: Returns and refunds at The Toronto Sauna Co.: cancel saunas and cold plunges before manufacturing starts, and return unopened accessories and heaters within 30 days.

blocks.html: Most saunas and cold plunges are built to order for you, so they work a little differently from in-stock items like accessories and heaters.
blocks.text: Most saunas and cold plunges are built to order for you, so they work a little differently from in-stock items like accessories and heaters.

blocks.html: Saunas, cold plunges and custom builds
blocks.text: Saunas, cold plunges and custom builds

blocks.html: Planning begins once your order is confirmed. You can cancel for a full refund any time before manufacturing begins.
blocks.text: Planning begins once your order is confirmed. You can cancel for a full refund any time before manufacturing begins.

blocks.html: Manufacturing usually starts 7 to 10 business days after your order is confirmed, and we email you when it does. Once manufacturing has started, the order can no longer be cancelled or refunded.

blocks.html: Unopened items in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery or pickup. Refunds go back to your original payment method, minus processing fees, credit card processing fees and shipping costs.

blocks.html: All opened items are final sale.

blocks.html: Email sales@thetorontosaunaco.com or call (437) 429-6623 with your order number so we can confirm the return. Then either bring the item to our showroom in Schomberg in person, by appointment, or ship it back to us at your cost.
